verses.text: The land share for Joseph’s descendants ran from the Jordan by Jericho and Jericho’s eastern waters, through the wilderness, and up the hills to Bethel. 🗺️
From Bethel it went to Luz, followed the Archite border to Ataroth, 🏔️
then west along the Japhletite border, past Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer, ending at the sea. 🌊
Joseph’s descendants—Manasseh and Ephraim—received their inheritance. 📜
Here’s Ephraim’s family boundary: on the east, from Ataroth-addar to Upper Beth-horon; 🗺️
it ran west to Michmethath on the north, turned east toward Taanath-shiloh, and passed east of Janoah. 🏔️
From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, reached Jericho, and came out at the Jordan. 🌊
From Tappuah the border ran west to the Kanah stream and ended at the sea. That was Ephraim’s inheritance by family. 🗺️
Ephraim also got towns set aside for them inside Manasseh’s inheritance—all those towns and their villages. 🏘️
But Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer. They still live among Ephraim to this day, doing forced labor. ⚠️
